items.q: Keith Hounslow trumpet... This was recorded on the 19th of June, 1951.

ctx.x: That might be the same as this particular tune that we're going to listen to. Emu Strut. And this is the Southern Jazz Group. The Southern Jazz Group. The Southern Jazz Group. The Southern Jazz Group. The Southern Jazz Group. The Southern Jazz Group. The Southern Jazz Group. 1950, issued on Swaggy JCS 33771. We're doing something a little bit different on Speakeasy Junction this evening. We're listening to Australian jazz recordings with our guest commentator, Mr. Eric Brown, who is filling us in on some of the…

Well, we continue on with the Southern Jazz Group, and near the end of their career in 1951, they put out an album of original compositions by Australian jazzmen. In fact, the Australian Broadcasting Commission did a series of programs featuring these compositions, and I think there were 45 in all that they played. And these are some from those particular sessions. Australian jazzmen seem to like to feature funny names of their titles, as you'll see as we go on. And they've got titles on this record like That…
